acceptanceCriteria.text: Room members-<uuid> and files-<uuid> pseudo-collections resolve to REAL Folder scenario-units (identity/parent/children as real links) — NOT 'no scenario'.

The folder detail renders a child-size SUNBURST diagram, RIDING R40.16's folder-as-unit + type-driven detail + child-size sunburst — verify-owner-first: reuse R40.16 (cc875e35), do NOT duplicate the folder model or the sunburst renderer.

[VERIFIED BY US @390 real-WebKit + live MEMBER session (tester gate r4022, WS IDENTIFY, no owner rights), THEN Tron ACCEPTS] WE verify in-room Files/Members render as a REAL folder with a sunburst diagram in a live test-member room (member-gated, no owner rights, no security harness). Tron ACCEPTS delivered verified work — he experiences it @390, he does not run the test. Was: TRON-ONLY/never-headless/Tron-verifies (customer-not-tester correction).

The sunburst ARC SIZE = the ACTUAL ON-DISK CONTENT SIZE in BYTES, NOT a uniform per-file count (Tron 2026-09-01: 'the actual content size on disk, real bytes per file or child'). DERIVED metric per unit type: (1) a FILE's size = its byte size on disk; (2) a FOLDER's size = the RECURSIVE SUM of all descendant file bytes; (3) a VIRTUAL unit with no physical location (e.g. a room collection) = the recursive byte-sum of its RESOLVABLE children (it AGGREGATES its children's real bytes), which is 0 if none are byte-bearing; (4) EMPTY (0 children) = the defined empty-state (size 0, a defined empty ring, NEVER blank) — the existing empty-state AC still holds; (5) a ZERO-BYTE or no-bytes child renders a MINIMUM-visible arc (a small floor) so it does NOT vanish, preserving arc-count == direct-child-count. The PROPORTIONALITY discriminator is KEPT: LARGEST size = LARGEST arc — only the METRIC changes from count to bytes. @390 screenshot-checkable: a folder containing a large file shows a proportionally LARGER arc than a folder containing a small file (not equal arcs). stub-must-fail: uniform sizing (equal arcs for children of UNEQUAL byte size) => RED.

The live-insert WIRING (WS notify -> RbTraceTree.reDeriveDirectChildren -> view update) fires end-to-end on an insert, provable on SCRATCH WITHOUT owner identity (the mechanism is owner-agnostic once past the R33.1 guard). RED before the client-subscribe fix, GREEN after. It does NOT mock the mechanism under test: it tests the WIRING (a different, real mechanism), NEVER owner-auth. HARD CONSTRAINTS (PO ruling 2026-09-04): NO owner credential, NO fabricated identity, NO prod write — scratch seed-unit + scratch identity ONLY; the gate MUST be able to FAIL (red-before-green proven). If building it starts to require fabricating identity, STOP + escalate to PO: that means it has drifted into full-B (REFUSED).

Decisive question: if owner-auth were broken in prod, it would STILL go green => certifies nothing about the thing it names = harness-useless-200; green-forever-while-real-path-rots.

(2) SECURITY-ADJACENT: building an owner-credential-injection artifact next to the R33.1 boundary is security work = Tron-authorization ABSOLUTE, not held and not to be sought for a test fixture when narrow-B exists.
